messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — BrightForge (prospect) sent a request for custom billing on a 3yr $360k commitment. They want a non-standard schedule and a small holdback tied to SLA. Need Deal Desk + Finance + Security + Legal input. Full customer ask pasted below.

maria_sales: Customer proposed terms: 40% upfront, 25% on go-live milestone, remaining 35% split across years 2-3 with net-120 on those invoices. They also want a 10% holdback payable after a 12mo SLA review, and a 60-day PO acceptance window. They want POC credit $10k refundable if POC fails.

maria_sales: ```
Invoice schedule (requested):
Year 1: 40% upfront (wire) + 25% on go-live
Year 2: 17.5% invoiced net-120
Year 3: 17.5% invoiced net-120
Holdback: 10% held in escrow/credit until SLA 12mo review
PO window: 60 days to return signed PO
POC: 30-day pilot, $10k refundable credit if criteria unmet
```

alex_ps: Quick presales POV — they want a light pilot. We can run it on Dedicated or Hosted; Dedicated will cost us ~8k for infra. Refundable POC credit is doable but needs a clear acceptance checklist.

jake_dealdesk: Need reason for net-120 and holdback. 3yr commits usually get standard upfronts (50% or annual prepay) + standard SLA crediting, not escrow. What discount are they expecting vs rate card?

maria_sales: They argue cash flow constraints; want to minimize upfront. They're asking effectively for a deeper concession to keep committed dollars. No explicit discount % in email — they asked for terms instead of list price.

rachel_finance: Net-120 is high risk without credit. We require a credit check and CFO signoff for net>90. For holdbacks: prefer escrow or letter of credit, not ledger offsets. ACH or wire preferred. Need billing contact and PO details before we can approve.

devon_security: We need completed security questionnaire + SOC2 Type II report before any production access. Also confirm data residency and whether customer will send production data during POC. No production access until SecOps signs off. Send sec questionnaire link to them.

billing-bot: Ticket BL-4287 created for custom billing terms (assigned to rachel_finance).

jake_dealdesk: Proposal from Deal Desk: provisional approval IF customer agrees to either 50% upfront (instead of 40%) OR keep 40% upfront but provide a letter of credit/escrow for the 10% holdback. Also push net-120 -> net-90 for years 2-3. POC credit OK if documented in SOW and refundable only if acceptance criteria in SOW not met.

sandra_legal: Looping in Legal — need exact contract language for holdback and POC credit. If escrow is used, legal needs the escrow agreement terms. Can we get the customer's redline or do they want us to produce language? I can turn around a draft in 24-48h if we have the precise schedule.

maria_sales: Customer is pushing to close this week. I'll ask them to accept the letter-of-credit option and confirm billing contact + PO. Also will push for net-90 instead of net-120.

alex_ps: I'll prepare a short SOW for the POC with acceptance criteria and estimated infra cost. Will include the refundable $10k credit clause and tie it to the checklist.

rachel_finance: If they accept letter of credit or escrow and net-90, finance can sign off pending credit check. Please route company legal name, billing address, and intended payment method.

devon_security: Sent sec questionnaire link to customer's security contact. Requested SOC2 report and data flow diagram.

maria_sales: Thanks all — next steps: 1) I ask customer to accept LOA/escrow + net-90 2) Alex will upload SOW + POC checklist 3) Legal will draft holdback clause 4) Finance runs credit check. Will update thread when customer responds. :eyes:
